title: Fixed Income Blog - EUR HICP market preview

classification.rationale: The note previews the September euro-area HICP release with detailed forecasts for energy, food, core and services, then adds a neutral EUR inflation-market view and a French CPI vs HICP widener trade.
classification.runner_up_reason: It also covers HICP fixings, valuations and a 10y FR CPI/EUR HICP widener, but most of the text is the data forecast.
